scripts.build:data: npm run build -w build && node build/dist/index.js
scripts.build:all: npm run build:data && npm run build:site && npm run build:mediawiki
scripts.clean: rm -rf site/dist site/public/data site/public/icons site/public/builds.json build/dist
scripts.build:mediawiki: npm run build -w mediawiki && node mediawiki/dist/index.js
scripts.publish:mediawiki: npm run build -w mediawiki && node mediawiki/dist/publish.js
